title: Cloned query
statement: Let a repeated query scope on $X$ have $r$ positions. For a natural number $M$ and an assignment of a clone index in $\\{0,\\ldots,M-1\\}$ to each position, the cloned query at each position is the ordered pair consisting of its queried element of $X$ and its assigned clone index.
